verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs say it offers AI dictation via Voxtype. Holding F9 or toggling Super + Ctrl + X puts the dictated text into whatever input area has focus, which covers system-wide dictation. It appears to need a separate install step ("Once installed"), and the docs give little depth. Missing for 10: confirmation that dictation is preinstalled rather than an optional install, details on model/language/accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate text anywhere in the system using built-in AI dictation

citations.quote: Omarchy offers AI dictation via Voxtype.
Once installed, you dictate by holding down `F9` or by toggling with `Super + Ctrl + X`, and the dictated text will appear in the focused input area.
